text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- South Korea's Daewoo Heavy Industries is biggest foreign investor in Romania so far with $209 million put in two Romanian joint ventures.
ADEVARUL
- State pensions to rise by 7.0 percent starting October.
- Over-the-counter market will soon become operational in Romania to trade mass privatisation shares.
- January-August inflation was 27 percent.
TINERETUL LIBER
- Romania is among top 10 largest furniture makers in Europe.
- Czech Skoda carmaker to sell Tatra trucks on Romania's market.
LIBERTATEA
- New consortia are being formed to bid for GSM licence.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Romanian private company Ana Industries bought 51 percent of electric motor maker Motoare Electrice Pitesti.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Former union leader Miron Mitrea, vicepresident of ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) says PDSR hopes to get 40 percent of parliamentary seats in the November 3 polls.
ADEVARUL
- From some 180 parties listed in Romania, only 51 were officialy re-registered with courts under new parties' law.
- Not all 1.6 million voters in Bucharest will have their voting cards ready on election day, said mayor Victor Ciorbea.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- World Health Organisation recommended tourists to avoid visiting Romania due to viral meningitis epidemic which killed 32 people.
- Gyorgy Frunda, candidate of Hungarian Democratic Union (UDMR), registered his candidacy for the November 3 presidential polls.
LIBERTATEA
- Lower Chamber of Deputies voted penal code bill.
CRONICA ROMANA
- Senate commission which investigated December 1989 events to hand over 1,000-page report.
- Nicu Ceausescu, youngest son of late dictator Nicolae Ceausescu, is in critical state in Bucharest hospital.
- New penal code sets bail at 2.0 million lei.
COTIDIANUL
- Ethnic Hungarian Reformed Bishop Laszlo Tokes says in interview Hungary betrayed ethnic Hungarians by signing treaty with Romania.
VOCEA ROMANIEI
- Ruling PDSR launches today electoral programme for the November 3 general election.
ZIUA
- One-page report on wedding of Princess Margaret, eldest daughter of ex-king Michael and Romanian actor Radu Duda due in Lausanne, Switzerland, on September 21.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Report on women working on Romanian army task force.
AZI
- Newspaper prints report on stages for NATO integration.
JURNALUL NATIONAL
- Madalin Voicu, president of Social Liberty and Unity Party (PLUS) puts number of Romanian Gypsies at three million.

- Star gymnast Nadia Comaneci and her American gymnast husband Bart Conner to attend ceremony marking 90 years since creation of Romanian gymnastics federation on September 24. ($=3,205 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
